title: Lane C P1.2: Live Provider Invocation Evidence Emission and Routed-Gateway Provenance Honesty
summary: Wired the P1.1 normalized ProviderInvocationOutcome contract into live adapter execution for Gemini, Anthropic, and OpenAI-compatible (OpenAI/DeepSeek/OpenRouter) adapters. Fixed a P1.1 partial defect where Anthropic streaming handlers were not updated to use named cache token fields. Extended LLMChunk with optional invocation_outcome field (non-breaking). Gemini now emits live outcomes with typed safety classification for errors and safety blocks. Anthropic preserves cache evidence as named fields in both streaming and non-streaming paths. OpenAIAdapter preserves provider identity from config, distinguishing DeepSeek (DIRECT_INFERENCE) from OpenRouter (ROUTED_GATEWAY) from OpenAI (DIRECT_INFERENCE). Updated invocation-evidence capability inspection with live-emission flags. 140 tests pass; all predecessor regressions clean.

sections.content: P1.1 updated AnthropicMapper.parse_response and AnthropicMapper._handle_message_start to use named cache fields, but the AnthropicAdapter has its own separate streaming event handlers (_parse_message_start at line 548, _parse_message_delta at line 652) that were NOT updated. These adapter-level handlers continued summing cache tokens into prompt_tokens. P1.2 fixed both adapter-level handlers to emit cache_read_tokens and cache_creation_tokens as named LLMUsage fields and wired invocation outcomes at the terminal streaming event.
Invocation Evidence Capability: Live Emission Flags

OpenRouter is executed through the OpenAI-compatible adapter. Its response shape is compatible with /chat/completions but does not include downstream provider/model metadata in the standard response body. OpenRouter may expose this via x-provider response headers or a generation-detail endpoint, but extracting it would require: (1) response header access at the adapter level (not currently passed through), or (2) a separate read call after completion. Both require coordination with GenericBackend and would add complexity without proven value. Decision: preserve OpenRouter as ROUTED_GATEWAY with honest unavailable provenance (GatewayProvenanceSource.UNAVAILABLE). Park extraction for a future slice that can prove safe, read-only, optional, non-routing provenance retrieval.
